title: Perleberger Straße, Berlin
description:
Spacious maisonette apartment on the fourth and fifth floor with elevator in a Berlin apartment house

This 180 sqm apartment is derived from the Fritz Schloss park which is close to the apartment.

The huge apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, two nice and spacy bathrooms a big living room with a huge terrace. There are 5 bedrooms: 4 bedrooms have Queen-Size beds and one bedroom with twin beds. Optional mobile beds for two more guests can be added. The kitchen has a modern stove, dishwasher, a big fridge with freezer, coffee brewer, water cooker and much more. The window view on the backyard is like a look back in the history of this part of Berlin and shows the old brick building of a two-storey horse stable, which belongs to the blacksmith workshop around the corner.

Located in the North of Tiergarten Park close to the inner city airport Tegel in a quiet backyard location. The next underground station (Birkenstrasse) and the next S-Bahn station (Westhafen) are about 700 meters away. Bus stops of line 123 are about 300 meters from the apartment, which takes you in a few minutes to the main train station (Hauptbahnhof). From there the political city centre with the Reichstag building and Brandenburg Gate are easy to reach.

Optimal S-Bahn connection, shopping opportunities on the famous Kurfürstendamm, interesting architecture and exciting cultural offers are within walking distance. The building is equipped with an elevator and has a charming back yard with a sandpit for toddlers.

Sehr charmante Wohnung direkt am Ku'Damm. Ausgestattet mit einem sehr hochwertigen „Ruf-Bett“ und Fußbodenheizung können Sie einziehen und sich sofort wohlfühlen. Sie werden von der tollen Umgebung fasziniert sein. In der besten Gegend von Berlin gelegen, genießen Sie Ihren Kurztrip oder Ihren längeren Aufenthalt. Wir freuen uns, Sie begrüßen zu dürfen.
Die wunderschöne Lage lässt kaum Wünsche offen. Trotz der Lage im zweiten Hinterhof hat man vom Fenster aus einen freien Blick über die Dächer in Richtung Spree. Fußläufig erreicht man zahlreiche Verkehrsanbindungen an Busse (Richtung U9 / Hauptbahnhof) und an die Ringbahn. Mit dem Fahrrad ist z.B. die Technische Universität in 10 Minuten zu erreichen. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten für den alltäglichen Bedarf sowie Cafés und Restaurants finden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe entlang der Turmstraße und in der historischen Arminius-Markthalle. Entlang der Spree kann man zu Fuß ins Stadtzentrum laufen (Reichstag, Brandenburger Tor).  
The fully furnished apartment is bright and very quiet on the fourth (top) floor of a rear building. Despite the location in the second backyard, you have an unobstructed view from the window over the rooftops in the direction of the Spree.Within walking distance you can reach numerous transport connections to buses (direction U9 / Hauptbahnhof) and to the urban train (Ringbahn). By bike, e.B. the Technical University can be reached in 10 minutes. Shopping facilities for everyday needs as well as cafés and restaurants can be found in the immediate vicinity along Turmstraße and in the historic Arminius market hall. Along the Spree you can walk to the city center (Reichstag, Brandenburg Gate).
Please Note: If we accept you as a tenant please deliver the following documents within 4 days: proof of enrolment at your school / university,  a bank statement which proves sufficient funds avalilable to pay the rent, a work contract and the last two payroll are also suitable.

title: Bismarckstraße, Berlin
description:
EN: (German description below)

The apartment is located in the heart of Charlottenburg, close to Kurfürstendamm on one side and Charlottenburg Palace on the other, right next to the Deutsche Oper. Two subway lines are just a few steps from the front door.
Wilmersdorferstrasse, one of Berlin's oldest pedestrian zones, with all its shopping opportunities is just a few steps away, as is Karl-August-Platz, where you can visit one of Berlin's most beautiful weekly markets every Wednesday and Saturday.

Of course, a fully equipped kitchen with all utensils, as well as towels and bed linen belong to the apartment, so the tenant can move in with only his personal belongings.
A good internet connection (250 MB) with stable WLAN allows an uncomplicated working from home.
There is a possibility to choose the rental period variably.

The landlord speaks German and English and lives in the same house in another apartment, so that any questions can be clarified directly and quickly.

All costs are included in the rental price! There is only one condition on the part of the landlord that the tenant properly officially registered! 

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

DE:

Die Wohnung liegt im Herzen von Charlottenburg, nahe dem Kurfürstendamm auf der einen Seite und dem Schloss Charlottenburg auf der anderen Seite, direkt an der Deutschen Oper. Zwei U-Bahnlinien liegen nur wenige Schritte von der Haustür entfernt.
Die Wilmersdorferstraße, eine der ältesten Fußgängerzonen Berlins, mit all seinen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten liegt nur  wenige Schritte entfernt, genauso wie der Karl-August-Platz, an dem man jeden Mittwoch und Samstag einen der schönsten Wochenmärkte Berlins besuchen kann.

Selbstverständlich gehören eine komplett eingerichtete Küche mit allen Utensilien, sowie Handtücher und Bettwäsche zur Wohnung, sodass der Mieter nur mit seinen persönlichen Sachen einziehen kann.
Eine gute Internetverbindung (250 MB) mit stabilem WLAN ermöglicht ein unkompliziertes Arbeiten von zuhause aus.
Es besteht die Möglichkeit, die Mietdauer variabel zu wählen.

Der Vermieter spricht deutsch und englisch und wohnt im gleichen Haus in einer anderen Wohnung, sodass eventuelle Fragen direkt und schnell geklärt werden können.

Im genannten Mietpreis sind sämtlichen Kosten enthalten! Es gibt nur die eine Bedingung seitens des Vermieters, dass sich der Mieter ordnungsgemäß behördlich anmeldet!

Right in the center and still quiet,
surrounded by parks (also with lake bathing beach) Wedding is one of the greenest districts of Berlin City area and elected Berlins coolest neighborhood by international Time out magazine.
Bus and tram station is just around the corner, several subway  (U-bahn and S-bahn), that connects to all parts of the city are reached within a maximum of 10 minutes walking distance, as well the High street Müllerstraße with shops for every need.
Of course there are Restaurants, Bars, Cafés for every taste in Wedding.


Deutsch:
Komplett renovierte und restaurierte, gemütlich, liebevoll und modern eingerichtete Wohnung in einer 
Remise mit loftartigem Grundschnitt, offenem Küchen-Ess- und Wohnbereich, separatem Schlafbereich, Tageslichtbad und eigener Terrasse (vorraussichtlich im Mai fertig gestellt) im sehr ruhigen Hinterhof.
Perfekt für Singles oder Paare.
Voll eingerichtet und ausgestattet mit allem, was man im Alltag benötigt .
Die Lage im grünen, zentralen, Berliner Wedding, übrigens vom Time Out Magazin zum coolsten Stadtteil Berlins gekürt lässt keine Wünsche offen;
umgeben von Parks mit Strandbad und guter Verkehrsanbindung, 
fußläufig in ca.10 Minuten sind diverse S- Ubahnlinen erreichbar, die mit allen Teilen Berlins verbinden, Straßenbahn und Busse sind praktisch um die Ecke.
Ebenfalls ca. 10 Minuten Fußweg entfernt liegt die Müllerstraße, eine Hauptgeschaftsstraße, zahlreiche Restaurants, Bars, Cafés für jeden Geschmack sind selbstverständlich ebenfalls im Bezirk zu finden .

title: Brunnenstraße, Berlin
description:
Overview
- Central location in Mitte, close to Arkonaplatz, Kastanienallee, Torstr. 
- Building modernized in 2017 - Refurnished in 2022 
- Supermarkets and Shops in walkable distance
- Subway (U8) and Tram (M10, M8, 12) stops very close
- Real wood parquet flooring
- Premium bath and kitchen
- Bedroom with 6-door wardrobe
- 1GBit/s internet connection
- Desk with 27" 4K display in the bedroom
- Home cinema with LG 65" 4K HDR TV and LG 2.1 Soundbar
- Smarthome: Heating, living room lighting


Very cosy apartment in one of the best (hidden) of Mitte between Arkonaplatz/Kastanienallee, Torstraße/Scheunenviertel and the Berlin Wall Memorial.

Enjoy a freshly (2022) furnished apartment with parquet floor in all rooms, lots of storage and a clever room design.

Relax in a cosy living room with a LG 4K 65" HDR Smart-TV that gives you a home cinema feeling. Smart light bulbs let you dial in  the right ambiance for the whole room.

The apartment features a premium kitchen equipped with everything you need from fridge to dishwasher. There is even a Sodastream, an air fryer, a Tassimo coffee machine and a washing machine with integrated dryer.

In the bedroom, there is a comfy 140cm wide bed with a spring mattress (20cm thick). The 6 door bedroom wardrobe offers a lot of space for all your clothing - and more.

Also, a small desk to work from home is located in the bedroom - outfitted with a 27" Dell 4K display. The apartment has Gigabit internet and a Wifi 6 router for maximum speed.

The whole building is equipped with a master key system: One key opens everything. There is also a video intercom installed.

Public transportation: Subway station of line U8 right in front of the building, trams M10, M8 and 12 very close by.
Long distance train stations Berlin Central and Berlin Gesundbrunnen are just a few minutes by taxi/tram/subway away.

There are bike racks and lockable bike storage room.

Supermarkets, shops, restaurants, bars, parks and nearly everything else you'd ever need are in walking distance.

title: Kurfürstenstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your cozy and comfortable home in the heart of Berlin! 

This furnished apartment offers everything you need for a relaxing and productive stay.   

The spacious living room features a sofa (bed), a TV, a dining table, also as work desk. You can enjoy the natural light and the city view from the large windows or the balcony, where you can also see the famous KaDeWe department store.  The bedroom has a comfortable King size bed, a wardrobe, and a private shower. The kitchen is fully equipped. The separate toilet is clean and modern.  
The apartment is located on the 9th floor of a secure building with an elevator. 

It is close to the Kurfürstendamm, one of the most popular shopping and entertainment streets in Berlin. You can walk to many cafes, restaurants, bars, cinemas, and theaters. You can also easily access public transportation, such as buses, subways, and trains, to explore other parts of the city. 

 If you have a car, you can request a private parking spot for an extra fee. The apartment is available for short-term or long-term rentals.

title: Lehrter Straße, Berlin
description: "Discover the epitome of modern living in the heart of Berlin! This chic and compact 25sqm apartment in a new building completed in 2020 offers everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle. Furnished with a cozy couch bed and including all electronics, from a smart TV to kitchen appliances, moving in is a breeze. The sleek walking shower adds a touch of luxury, while the practical working desk and convenient eating corner make it easy to both work and dine in style. Enjoy the building's amenities such as the lobby lounge, concierge service, and gym, and take advantage of the elevator for added convenience. With a supermarket just a minute's walk away and the main train station within easy reach, this apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in a prime location. Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience urban living .

title: Kolberger Straße, Berlin
description: Super location, clean and modern! This flat is located in Wedding/Mitte close to S-Bahn Humboldthain, U-Bahn Reinickendorfer Straße. Bright, clean and modern  1 bedroom apartment with 1 open living/kitchen room setting, comfortable green private balcony in a modern building (elevator), 1st floor. Wifi, Phone,  2 TV's  and all included. Perfect for a professional or a couple that wants to spend a few months in Berlin.

title: Grolmanstraße, Berlin
description:
Exclusive, fully furnished apartment in the heart of Charlottenburg, very central location. Between Ku’Damm and Savignyplatz. Upper class neighborhood.

Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf ist der gefragteste Stadtteil in der
City-West. Dank seiner zentralen Lage, der guten Verkehrsanbindungen und der perfekten Infrastruktur gehört das Viertel zwischen Kurfürstendamm und Kantstraße zu den begehrtesten Lagen der City-West. Die Ulmenbäume tauchen diese
Straße schon früh im Jahr in ein grünes Blätterkleid. Lietzenseepark und Stuttgarter Platz sind echte Magneten und fußläufig zu erreichen. Hier laden Boutiquen, Cafés und Restaurants, Kinos und Theater zum Flanieren und Verweilen ein. Die Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr könnte besser nicht sein. Den Flughafen BER erreichen Sie über die nahe Stadtautobahn und den Bahnhof Charlottenburg in etwa 30 Minuten.

title: Provinzstraße, Berlin

description:
Very central, bright, freshly renovated and furnished 2-room apartment on the 3rd floor with an elevator between Rosenthaler Platz and Nordbahnhof (S-Bahn)

- Dining table with four chairs
- Bookshelf
- Carpet

- 2-floor lamps

- Carpet

- Fridge and freezer combination

Hall:

- Smart thermostat from Tado built-in for additional convenience and controllable via the Tado app
- Lift
- Central heating for heating and hot water
- Professional cleaning every 14 days (2 hours of cleaning every other week)

Location:
Very close to Rosenthaler Platz (which has developed into the centre of creative and digital culture in recent years), the very central location of this apartment is hardly adequately described: the central train station, Charité, and Hackescher Markt are all within a kilometre, Museum Island with cathedral and Alexanderplatz as well as the essential government offices from the Chancellery to the Reichstag and Bundestag offices to the new head(hidden) of the Federal Intelligence Service.

The variety of shopping opportunities (REWE, BioCompany, DM, ...), gastronomy and entertainment can hardly be topped.

Regarding the transport connections, it is approx. 5 mn on foot to the Nordbahnhof (S 1/2/25/26), nine mn to the underground station Naturkundemuseum (U 6), and nine mn to the underground station Rosenthaler Platz (U 8). The stops for tram lines 12 and M8 and the bus line N40 are practically on the doorstep (Pappelplatz).

Additional Information
The monthly rent includes a mandatory professional cleaning service for the apartment, conducted every other week, each session lasting two hours. Any cleaning sessions that cannot be held due to holidays, illness, or similar reasons will be rescheduled. The scheduling of these cleaning sessions will be coordinated directly between the tenant and the cleaning staff. 

The broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbetrag) associated with the apartment is not included in the all-inclusive rent. The tenant must pay this fee directly to the designated tax office.

title: Guerickestraße, Berlin
description: Renting out a room (WG Zimmer) in former Bar in the heart of Charlottenburg (close to Ernst-Reuter-Platz). Apartment has a total of 5 rooms and 2 bathrooms for 4 flatmates in total. The apartment and the rooms are fully furnished and ready to move in. Anmeldung is possible.

title: Perleberger Straße, Berlin
description:
This stylish maisonette apartment offers modern comfort and innovative design. Downstairs, the open-plan living area includes a fully equipped kitchen (oven, microwave-combi, mobile cooking field, dishwasher, compact fridge) and efficient underfloor heating. A large rooftop window above the stairs and a glass section of the upstairs floor ensure the kitchen is bathed in natural light.


Upstairs, the bedroom opens onto a small terrace, offering a private outdoor space. A fold-down desk is conveniently located next to the bed, perfect for work or study. The bathroom is equipped with a shower. The apartment also features clever storage solutions, with a built-in cabinet in the floor upstairs, making the most of every inch of space in this well-designed maisonette.

The apartment is located in the North of Tiergarten Park close to the inner city airport Tegel in a quiet backyard location. The next underground station (Birkenstrasse) and the next S-Bahn station (Westhafen) are about 700 meters away. Bus stops of line 123 are about 300 meters from the apartment, which takes you in a few minutes to the main train station (Hauptbahnhof). From there the political city centre with the Reichstag building and Brandenburg Gate are easy to reach.

You live centrally in the beautiful green area of Wedding, not far from the center, at the melting pot of the cultural, music, fashion and creative scene.

description: Nestled in the lively and multicultural district of Wedding, this newly renovated apartment offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and urban living. This lively street seamlessly transitions into Brunnenstrasse, leading to the iconic Bernauer Strasse. Tenants should have liability insurance as well as household insurance.

title: Chausseestraße, Berlin
description:
This stunning 2-room apartment (65 sqm) is located in the heart of Mitte and offers a bright, modern living experience in one of Berlin’s most sought-after and safest neighborhoods. Flooded with natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows, the apartment features a spacious open-plan layout that is ideal for singles or couples.
The open American-style kitchen seamlessly connects to the dining and living area, creating a generous and inviting space for everyday living as well as entertaining. The kitchen is fully equipped with high-quality appliances, including a microwave, toaster, kettle, and all essential cookware, crockery, and utensils. The dining area flows naturally into the living room, which offers a comfortable and stylish setting to relax. A dedicated home office area with a height-adjustable desk and an ergonomic office chair makes the apartment perfectly suited for remote work.
A true highlight of the apartment is the south-facing balcony, which enjoys sunshine throughout the day. It is furnished with a sun lounger, an outdoor dining table with chairs, and a gas BBQ—ideal for outdoor meals or unwinding after a long day in the city. Despite its central location, the apartment is exceptionally quiet.
The bedroom offers ample storage and a comfortable sleeping setup with a 160 cm bed. For warmer summer months, a fan is provided. The bedroom is directly connected to the spacious, modern bathroom, which features both a separate shower and a bathtub, offering a spa-like experience.
The apartment is located directly at the Naturkundemuseum stop and within immediate proximity to Berlin Central Station, Friedrichstraße, and Nordbahnhof, providing excellent connectivity to Prenzlauer Berg, Rosenthaler Platz, and beyond. Daily necessities such as supermarkets, bakeries, drugstores, and a wide variety of cafés and restaurants are just two minutes from the front door.
All utilities, including high-speed WiFi, electricity, and water, are included in the monthly rent. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible. This apartment is a true dream home—perfect for starting your life in Berlin with comfort, style, and convenience.

description:
Cozy, möbliertes Apartment mit großen Balkon im beliebten Sprengelkiez

Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause! Dieses helle und geschmackvoll möblierte 1-Zimmer-Apartment bietet Ihnen auf 35 m2 alles, was Sie für einen komfortablen Aufenthalt in der Hauptstadt benötigen.

Dank der tollen Lage im angesagten Sprengelkiez haben Sie nette Cafés, Restaurants, kulturelle Highlights und eine hervorragende Anbindung an den Nahverkehr direkt vor der Haustür. Sie können sofort einziehen und sich wohlfühlen!

Die Highlights der Wohnung im Überblick:
•	Größe: 35 m2 (1 Zimmer, Küche, Bad)
•	Lage: Top-Lage mit schneller Verbindung zum Hauptbahnhof
•	Ausstattung: Komplett möbliert und bezugsfertig
•	Besonderheit: Eigener, großzügiger Balkon

Wichtige administrative Hinweise:
•	Eine offizielle Anmeldung beim Bürgeramt ist problemlos möglich. (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung)
•	Rundfunkbeitrag: Bitte beachten Sie, dass in Deutschland bei einer offiziellen Anmeldung die gesetzliche Rundfunkgebühr anfällt. Diese ist vom Mieter direkt an den Beitragsservice zu entrichten und beträgt aktuell knapp 19€ pro Monat 

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Anfrage und darauf, Sie bald in Berlin willkommen zu heißen!



Cozy Furnished 35 sqm Apartment with Balcony in the vibrant Sprengel Kiez in Berlin Mitte

Welcome to your new home! This bright and beautifully furnished 1-bedroom apartment offers everything you need for a comfortable stay in the capital.

The apartment not only features a nicely designed living and sleeping area, but it also boasts its own private balcony—the perfect spot to start your day with a morning coffee or unwind in the evening with a glass of wine. There is a day bed that serves as a cozy sofa during the day and can be easily extended into a double bed. There is bed linen for 2 persons.
Located right in the vibrant center of the "Sprengelkiez" , you will have trendy cafes, restaurants, cultural highlights, and excellent public transport connections right at your doorstep. Just bring your suitcases and settle in!

•	Location: Prime location in the highly sought-after Berlin Mitte district, with a quick connection to the to the main station

We look forward to receiving your booking request and welcoming you to Berlin soon!

title: Fehmarner Straße, Berlin
description:
Die elegante Wohnung liegt in der Fehmarnerstrasse am Sprengelkietz. Sie hat zwei wohldurchdachte Zimmer, in denen es sich sehr schoen leben laesst- alles ist vorhanden um sich in einem sehr ansprechenden Umfeld heimisch zu fuehlen- bei der Einrichtung wurde nicht gespart.

Man betritt die Wohnung durch einen doppelt gesicherten geraumigen Flur, das Schlafzimmer ist separat und mit einem Doppelbett ausgestattet das Badezimmer hat  fuenf Sterne Qualität. Ins Wohnzimmer integriert gibt es eine großzügige geschnittene Küche in der sich die wichtigsten Utensilien befinden und auch eine Geschirrspülmaschine.

Die Ausstattung ist sehr hochwertig.

Am Nordufer naehe Mitte ist Weddings Bestlage.
Die Küche grenzt in offener Bauweise an das gemütliche Wohnzimmer an.
zum Schlafen steht ein 1,60m grosses Doppelbett zur Verfügung und für Besuch gibt es noch eine Ausziehcouch im Wohnzimmer.
Beide Fenster führen zum ruhigen Innenhof.
Zur Wohnung selbst gehört auch ein kleines Stück Garten, in dem man gerne heimisch werden kann.

Der Sprengelkiez an der Grenze zu Mitte ist Weddings Bestlage- das liegt vor allem an dem fußläufig zu erreichenden Nordufer das zum Sitzen und Flanieren einlaed und den vielen kleinen charmanten Geschäften und Restaurants die sich in unmittelbarer Umgebung befinden.
Ein wesentlicher Vorteil dieser Nordufer Lage ist, dass man sowohl die City West als auch das moderne Mitte sehr gut erreicht. In kurzer Zeit ist man am Hauptbahnhof und mit der U-bahn Linie 9 in einer Viertelstunde am Bahnhof Zoo- auch die Stadtautobahn ist nah genug um sie schnell zu erreichen und entfernt genug um diese ruhige und idyllische Lage nicht zu stoeren.
 Die Kaution kann bei Bedarf auch gesplittet bezahlt werden.
Anmeldung ist moeglich.

title: Jülicher Straße, Berlin
description:
Fully Furnished Modern Apartment – Berlin-Mitte / Gesundbrunnen
Excellent Location • 200 m to U/S-Bahn • 100 m to Shopping Center • Fitness Room • Rooftop Terrace
Location: Jülicher Straße 16–17, 13357 Berlin
Modern, fully furnished apartment in the contemporary CAMPUS VIVA Berlin residential complex in Berlin-Mitte/Gesundbrunnen.
The apartment offers an excellent combination of private living, modern furnishings, extensive communal facilities and outstanding public transport connections. It is ideal for professionals, employees, researchers, trainees and students looking for a comfortable and conveniently located home in Berlin.
The Apartment
The apartment is fully furnished and ready to move into. It has been designed to make efficient use of the available space while providing everything necessary for comfortable everyday living.
The apartment includes a private bathroom and private kitchenette, together with furnishings such as a bed, mattress, desk, chair, wardrobe, storage furniture and other practical furnishings. The original CAMPUS VIVA specification describes the apartments as fully equipped with their own bathroom and pantry kitchen. 
Outstanding Location & Transportation
One of the apartment's greatest advantages is its exceptionally convenient location:
•	Approx. 200 m to U-Bahn and S-Bahn 
•	Approx. 100 m to Gesundbrunnen-Center shopping mall 
•	Approx. 50 m to sports/recreational area 
•	Approx. 500 m to Volkspark Humboldthain 
•	Excellent connections to Berlin-Mitte and the rest of Berlin 
These distances are stated in the original CAMPUS VIVA project exposé. 
Bahnhof Gesundbrunnen is one of Berlin's major transportation hubs. It provides connections to the U8, S-Bahn, Ringbahn S41/S42, regional trains and long-distance ICE/IC/EC services, making the apartment particularly convenient for anyone commuting within Berlin or regularly traveling outside the city. 
The exposé indicates travel times of approximately 8 minutes to Alexanderplatz, 9 minutes to Friedrichstraße/Humboldt University and 10 minutes to Brandenburg Gate by public transportation. 
Shopping Only 100 Meters Away
The Gesundbrunnen-Center is approximately 100 meters from the building and provides more than 100 shops, making groceries, shopping and everyday necessities exceptionally convenient.
The surrounding neighborhood also offers numerous cafés, shops and services. 
Extensive Facilities for Residents
CAMPUS VIVA offers much more than a conventional apartment building. Residents have access to extensive communal facilities, including:
•	Fitness room with exercise equipment 
•	Three lounges 
•	Large rooftop terrace 
•	Large garden terrace 
•	Study/work room 
•	Fully equipped communal kitchen 
•	Laundry center 
•	Table-football room 
•	Table tennis on the rooftop terrace 
The building's original project documentation confirms these communal facilities. 
The large rooftop and garden terraces provide attractive outdoor areas for relaxing, working or enjoying time outside. The rooftop terrace also offers views across Berlin. 
Green & Recreational Areas Nearby
For outdoor recreation, Volkspark Humboldthain is approximately 500 meters away. The approximately 29-hectare park includes extensive green areas, a rose garden, vineyard and outdoor swimming pool. 
A sports/recreational area is approximately 50 meters from CAMPUS VIVA. 
Ideal for Professionals and Students
This apartment is particularly attractive for anyone looking for a modern, furnished home with excellent transportation, shopping and recreational facilities immediately nearby.
Whether you are relocating to Berlin for work, beginning a new professional position, conducting research, completing professional training or studying in Berlin, the apartment provides a practical home where you can move in without having to purchase furniture or equip an entire apartment.

This charming and fully renovated apartment combines historic character with modern comfort and is ideally suited for two students sharing or a couple seeking generous space in one of the most authentic parts of Berlin.

Apartment Highlights
	•	Located on the 3rd floor of a classic 1908 building
	•	Approx. 24 m2 spacious living room with balcony facing a very quiet street
	•	Separate bedroom facing the peaceful inner courtyard
	•	Two full beds, plus:
	•	A comfortable sofa bed in the larger room (easily extendable; suitable for one or two people)
	•	Two separate bathrooms:
	•	One with toilet and sink
	•	One with shower, sink, and elegant floor-heated terrazzo
	•	Completely renovated from scratch
	•	Brand-new kitchen and bathrooms
	•	Many preserved original details from 1908

The layout offers excellent privacy for two people, making it ideal for flat-sharing students or couples who appreciate separate sleeping and living areas.

⸻

The Neighborhood

The apartment is situated in a lively yet authentic Berlin neighborhood:
	•	Just 2 minutes from vibrant Badstraße with numerous restaurants and cafés
	•	Large supermarket open 7 days a week (7–24h)
	•	A large park with public swimming pool
	•	Boulder gym with public sauna
	•	Everything within comfortable walking distance

This is a dynamic, creative, and genuinely “Berlin” part of the city.

⸻

Outstanding Connectivity

Despite the quiet street, public transport connections are exceptional:
	•	Only 3 minutes on foot to the U8 subway
	•	Just 8 minutes to Alexanderplatz
	•	7 minutes walking distance to Berlin Gesundbrunnen station (Nordkreuz), with:
	•	Ringbahn trains
	•	Regional trains
	•	ICE high-speed trains

From here you reach:
	•	Berlin Main Station in approx. 4 minutes
	•	The airport in approx. 30 minutes
	•	City Center East in approx. 8 minutes

Whether by public transport or bike, you can get anywhere in the city quickly and efficiently.

⸻

If you are looking for a stylish, move-in-ready apartment with character, privacy, and superb connections — ideal for two students or a couple — this is a rare opportunity.

Please feel free to ask any questions.

title: Französische Straße, Berlin
description:
Take this chance to live in this wonderful property!

Dinner with friends, a literacy circle, a musical performance – happening in the comforts of your home: Star architect David Chipperfield has managed to revive a piece of the 19th century "salon life“ with Palais Varnhagen by creating salon apartments with spacious presentation areas and an interior reflecting this intention, with ceiling-high double-wing doors, beautiful panel parquet flooring and airy ceilings rising over three meters.

At the reception the concierge welcomes residents and visitors, assisting with queries or assignments at any time.

While salon life can blossom in the living and dining area, arranged with communicative seating, a simple partitioning preserves the resident’s sense of privacy. The spacious bedroom comes with a luxury double bed (180 x 200) and a small work/study desk on the window side. A built-in wardrobe offers plenty of room for storage. The kitchen is kept in warm colours and the high-quality built-in appliances provide for a user-friendly experience. There is an induction cooker, oven, fridge, freezer, dishwasher and dining table.

High-quality materials determine the interior of the bathroom as well. Colour and make of walls and flooring as well as bathtub and shower cabin correspondent, high-quality fittings resonate the elegance. More storage space can be found in the utility room beside the entrance, where also washing machine and dryer are located. Modern solar control glazing and a video intercom system complete the high-quality furnishings of the salon apartment.

Parking can be booked separately (120 Euro/month).

Equipment:
- Parking
- Concierge Service
- Video intercom system
- Lift
- Solar control glazing
- Large-sized panel parquet flooring
- Wifi 250 MBit

Living room:
- Sofa und seat by Dennis by koozo
- Sideboard Treku

Bedroom:
- Wardrobe by Filo
- Desk i-work desk by Bolia

Kitchen:
- Bosch induction cooker and oven with extraction hood
- Bosch fridge, separate freezer
- Bosch dishwasher

Bathroom:
- Bathtub with ZELLER bathtub board
- Shower cabin

Utility room:
- Bosch washing machine and dryer
- Godmorgon wardrobe

Others:
-The artwork on the wall in the living area has been removed.

The ‘Palais’ has been named after Rahel Varnhagen (1771–1833) - the Grande Dame of Berlin salon life. Only a few houses away from here, she hosted guests like Heinrich Heine, Friedrich Schlegel, Adelbert von Chamisso, Wilhelm und Alexander Humboldt as well as well as barons and princes. As it was then, Französische Strasse is a very special location still today: You can’t live more central in Berlin. Only one street further there is the Komische Oper, and towards South, along Friedrichstrasse, there is the famous Checkpoint Charlie. Towards North, you can pass is the subway station Friedrichstraße (U6 Tram 12/M1), cross the river Spree and arrive at Friedrichstadt Palast. In South West, there is Potsdamer Platz and the greens of Berliner Tiergarten, both also accessible by foot.
Next subway station: Französische Straße (U6).

description:
Bright and Well-Equipped Apartment in a Classic Berlin Altbau in Wedding

This bright and well-equipped apartment is located on the second floor (left wing) of a typical Berlin Altbau building. All windows face the quiet courtyard, allowing plenty of natural light to enter while shielding the apartment from street noise.

The apartment consists of one main room, a kitchen, and a bathroom with a window. The living/sleeping area is furnished with a double bed, a spacious wardrobe, dressers, a TV, and a desk ideal for working. The kitchen is fully equipped and also includes a washing machine. Additionally, you will find a kettle, toaster, coffee machine, and many other kitchen essentials. The dining table comfortably seats up to four people. The bathroom features a shower cabin.
Location

The apartment is situated in Wedding, a neighborhood that is part of the Berlin Mitte district. Nearby, you will find many shopping centers, small shops, bars, and convenience stores that are open around the clock. The Volkspark Rehberge, one of Berlin’s most beautiful and popular parks, is also within close walking distance.

Public transport connections are excellent. The Seestraße U-Bahn station (U6) connects to the eastern parts of the city, while Leopoldplatz station (U6 and U9) provides easy access to the western parts. The U9 line goes directly to the Zoological Garden. Major stations like Friedrichstraße and Kurfürstendamm are only a few minutes away by subway. Additionally, tram lines M13 and 50 are just a one-minute walk from the apartment, offering direct routes to Prenzlauer Berg and Friedrichshain.

This charming ALTBAU apartment has been decorated with an eye for design, primarily in black/white/grey but with splashes of pink colour and interesting features like the custom-made sofa in the large dining/office room, surrounded by a victorian bow-window facing the lively Zimmerstrasse. The spacious living room with 3 couches can be easily turned into a second indipendent bedroom. Further advantages are a balcony facing a quite courtyard and 2 bathrooms, one even displaying a bidet (rare in Germany).

The modern kitchen is entirely black and fully equipped, including all cooking and eating utensils + washing machine, dishwasher, oven, microwave, toaster, kettle, coffee machine and a few other useful appliances. Next to it a beautiful unique room, which can be used to work, to relax or to host up to 8 dining companions in a slightly-oversized wooden table. The large bedroom is cosy and displays: comfortable double bed, bed tables, cupboard, desk with chair, spacey wardrobe, blinding curtains, private bathroom with bidet, balcony.
Lage

This beautiful apartment lies in the heart of Berlin in the vibrant popular district of Mitte, within walking distance to all major tourist destinations but also to art galleries, shops, restaurants, clubs and bars.
The neighborhood is quiet at night, being the area close to Checkpoint Charlie mostly populated during the day.

Closest metro station: U6 Kochstraße/Checkpoint Charlie
Potsdamer Platz is also easy reachable on foot.
Closest bus stop: M29

Floor: 4th

This beautiful studio is centrally located at the very heart of Wilmersdorf near the Kurfürstendamm, in a charming old building.
The apartment itself consists of one room perfectly divided into living and sleeping area where you can relax after a long day at work or discovering this awesome city. It is furnished with a double sofa bed, large double closet and a set of drawers. The washing machine is also in the kitchen. The generously sized bathroom has a window and there is a shower. A wireless fast internet connection is certainly not missing. Strolling the Ku'damm and the smaller streets to both its banks, is not only pleasing and aesthetic, it allows visitors to capture the sophisticated, artistic and intellectual spirit of pre-war and current Berlin, better than any other part of the city. You can literally feel the beat that drove cultural life in this city in-between the wars, still beating today.

Bus (1 minute walk)
U2 Sophie-Charlotte-Platz: (5 minutes)

This is a group advertisement. The photos represent more than one flat and are sample pictures.

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your enrollment certificate, as well as a copy of your ID card or passport, and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit and our one-off handling fee (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

-----------------------------------------------

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

Discover the Vibrant Lifestyle of Berlin: A Hub for Living, Studying, and Working

Berlin, the dynamic capital of Germany, has firmly established itself as a city that seamlessly blends history, culture, and innovation. With its rich heritage, diverse population, and robust economy, Berlin has become a prime destination for individuals seeking a vibrant lifestyle while pursuing their educational and professional aspirations.

A Cultural Melting Pot: Berlin's allure lies in its diverse and inclusive atmosphere. It's a haven for artists, musicians, and creatives from all corners of the globe. The city's historic landmarks, such as the Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Wall, stand as powerful reminders of its past while providing a backdrop for contemporary expression. The thriving arts scene, world-class museums, and countless galleries offer a continuous source of inspiration.

Educational Excellence: Berlin boasts an array of prestigious universities and research institutions that draw students and academics from around the world. Institutions like Humboldt University and the Technical University of Berlin provide cutting-edge research opportunities and a wide range of study programs. Automobiles delightfully line the streets, as pedestrians happily and briskly walk to a variety of local destinations and attractions. 

Once inside the impressive studio, you find an open floor plan featuring dedicated spaces. Notice the high ceilings, neutral color scheme, and the phenomenal hardwood floors. Carefully laid in a herringbone pattern, the flooring is bursting with natural hues of amber, vanilla, and honey which supremely coalesce in a display of interior artistry. Flooding the space in a blanket of luminosity, natural light flows in through the bright windows and cascades across every corner.

Entertaining family and friends is easy and enjoyable with a contemporary and compact fully equipped kitchen (plates, pans, cups, etc.). Spend time browsing the internet via the included Wi-Fi and select a few recipes to prepare for your guests. Utilize the Bosch induction oven and range to create culinary perfection, as you select the fresh ingredients from the refrigerator and freezer. When your friends and family arrive, offer them a glass of wine from the bar or a cup of coffee from the included coffeemaker. While putting the finishing touches on the delicious fare, chat and laugh with guests as they comfortably sit in the living room. After dinner has been relished and the evening is coming to an end, give guests a rich selection of desserts from the beloved local bakeries. 
Evenings are always best spent in a state of tranquility and relaxation. Watch a classic film on the flatscreen television or opt to read a favorite piece of literature. After unwinding with stories, take a warm shower in the spa-inspired bathroom. Custom tilework adorns the walls in a consistent and luxurious fashion, while the rain showerhead offers a soothing and one-of-a-kind bathing experience. Sleek hardware with industrial design appeal creates a welcoming environment, while the raised basin sink provides a hint of chic antiquity as it remains distinctly modern. Finally, dress in your finest pajamas and cuddle beneath the covers in the bed. Bask in the comfort of the high-quality mattress and the early morning convenience of the sizeable wardrobe! 

Perfectly located, you are within a short walking distance (1-10 minutes) to public transportation and many amenities including Hackescher Market, M10, U Weinmeisterstraße, Monbijou Park, trendy restaurants, bars, cafes, schools, theaters, shopping, and the Spree River!

Additionally, the brand-new and fully furnished studio apartments rent for 3-12-month terms (2-month security deposit) and include utilities, Wi-Fi, washing machine, building elevator, and access to a private gym and lounge/library for residents only (to be opened in next several months).

Contact us today for your exclusive tour of this unique living experience!

description:

Our centrally located 4-Room shared flat is full of light and recently completely renovated. It’s a two-floors apartment.

This very special building is towards the facade of the DZ-Bank (German Central Cooperative Bank) Pariser Platz. Designed by the Canadian world-famous architect Frank O. Gehry in the style of deconstructivism. The front of the building faces the Brandenburg Gate, which is one of the best-known landmarks of Germany. A complete work of stone and glass in the form of a large cuboid. The building was occupied in 2001. On the north side there are office and conference tracts, on the south side the building accommodates 30 condominiums on seven floors. Their windows are unusually interlocked, because this is where the architect was allowed to realize his ideas – a real Gehry.

APARTMENT
This stunning high end, luxurious apartment extends over two floors. The view is very special. You can see from each room the grand Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe and Potsdamer Platz where film premieres in Germany take place. You have bright rooms with the highest comfort. You will find an open living space with a kitchen and a cozy sofa with a smart TV. The bedroom which is located upstairs, offers a high-quality mattresses. You’ll even have your own walk-in closet. The two bathrooms, one on each floor, offer a walk-in shower. The windows are triple glazed, so you won’t hear any noises from outside. The parquet floor is made of oak. There’s also a controlled residential ventilation in the building. There’s a safe, the instructions are in the apartment. Not a concierge, but a doorman. No freezing compartment, but a normal refrigerator available.

AREA
The buidling is situated in excellent inner-city location, connected to the grand boulevard Unter den Linden and only 2 minutes away from Brandenburger Gate, Pariser Platz. Your new neighbour? the Canadian Embassy and famous Hotel Adlon. The area experiences a renaissance as a glamorous place to go out and is on the way to becoming a Downtown district of an international format. You will find many cultural offers like the Friedrichstadtpalast and endless shops, bars and restaurants just around the corner. The transport link is ideal thanks to the central location.

title: Auguststraße, Berlin
description:
HOUSE:
The charming three story town house was built in 2008. 

APARTMENT:
This stunning three-bedroom townhouse is a rare luxury in the heart of Berlin, an extraordinary home that combines the privacy of a standalone residence with the sophistication of high-end design. Spread across three elegant floors plus a full private basement level, it offers the feeling of a secluded retreat right in the city center. A beautifully private front garden, accessible only to you and securely gated, creates a sense of calm and exclusivity from the moment you arrive. A second green courtyard between the garden and the street adds an additional layer of serenity, making the home remarkably quiet despite its prime location.

You enter into a bright, spacious, open-concept living and kitchen area where floor-to-ceiling glass brings in abundant natural light while the private garden ensures complete privacy. The living room features a generous, comfortable sofa and a dining table that seats six with ease, perfect for relaxed evenings or stylish entertaining. The state-of-the-art Bulthaup kitchen is a dream for anyone who loves to cook, fully equipped with premium Gaggenau appliances, including a five-burner gas stove that will delight culinary enthusiasts. A separate pantry behind the kitchen adds extra convenience and storage, and a guest toilet completes this level.

A beautifully crafted staircase with an iron balustrade and oak steps leads to the first floor, where two serene bedrooms overlook the lush private garden. Each bedroom comes with a double bed and ample storage space; one also includes a desk, ideal for working from home. The hallway is lined with an additional large wardrobe, ensuring that you’ll never run out of space for your clothes. The first-floor bathroom is impeccably designed, featuring a bathtub and a walk-in shower. Elegant slate wall tiles create a refined, spa-like atmosphere, enhanced by the natural daylight streaming in from a ceiling window.

The top floor is the true showpiece of the home: a breathtaking private terrace with an exclusive view of the historic former Imperial Post Office, its red-brick façade glowing beautifully in the afternoon sun. The room on this floor is wonderfully versatile: it can serve as an additional bedroom thanks to a sofa bed with a real mattress, or as a spectacular home office with a desk and inspiring panoramic views.

The private basement level offers even more space, with three rooms providing abundant storage. One room functions as a dedicated laundry area with the washing machine conveniently located there. Throughout the entire house, underfloor heating ensures a consistently warm and luxurious atmosphere.

Altogether, this exceptional townhouse blends luxury, privacy, and comfort in one of Berlin’s most desirable locations. An extraordinary home where every detail has been thoughtfully designed to create a truly elevated living experience.

AREA:
The area around the town house is an ideal starting point for expats who are just getting to know the city. Located in the heart of Mitte, it combines historic charm with a stylish, international atmosphere, offering a relaxed yet vibrant introduction to everyday life in Berlin. The neighborhood is full of small designer boutiques, independent fashion labels, bookshops, and concept stores, making it perfect for leisurely shopping without the crowds of large malls. Nearby streets like Linienstraße and Oranienburger Straße add even more variety, with lifestyle shops and creative studios tucked between cafés and galleries. Dining options are equally diverse: cozy cafés serving excellent pastries and specialty coffee sit next to modern restaurants offering cuisine from around the world, including Mediterranean, Japanese, vegan, and classic German dishes. Many places spill out onto the sidewalks in warmer months, creating a lively, friendly atmosphere. Art lovers will especially enjoy this part of Mitte, as Auguststraße is one of Berlin’s most renowned gallery streets, home to both established contemporary art galleries and smaller, experimental project spaces. Everyday conveniences are also close at hand, with supermarkets, organic shops, bakeries, pharmacies, and Spätis scattered throughout the neighborhood. Public transport connections are excellent, giving you quick access to trams, buses, and the U-Bahn, making it easy to explore the rest of the city. Altogether, the area offers a welcoming mix of culture, convenience, and character that makes settling into Berlin feel natural and enjoyable.

title: Potsdamer Straße, Berlin
description:
A combination of space and modernity, with plenty of natural light and an enviable location of Potsdamer Platz, whilst retaining a sense of privacy and surrounded by beautiful green spaces and excellent transportation links. Everything in the apartment is fitted for comfort and ease: from the large windows that flood the rooms with natural light, to the tiled bathrooms and plentiful kitchen space perfect for cooking and entertaining, this is the ideal place to live and work in Berlin.

The apartment is a 15 minute walk from Berlin Potsdamer Platz Bahnhof, a central station with local and regional services, including the S1, S1, S25 and S26. The flat sits directly across from Gleisdreieck Park and next to the Landwehr Canal; Berlin's famous Tiergarten is less than 15 minutes by foot. This combination of bustling city life and a peaceful natural environment offers the perfect balance for city life and is an exclusive offering in the Berlin rental market.

title: Markgrafenstraße, Berlin
description:
Stylish Fully Furnished 2-Bedroom Apartment in the Heart of Berlin – Markgrafenstraße 88

Welcome to your new home in one of Berlin's most vibrant and central neighbourhoods. This beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience — ideal for professionals, small families, or anyone seeking to enjoy city living at its best.

Apartment Features:
Fully furnished with tasteful, modern decor
Spacious living room perfect for relaxing or entertaining
Two generous bedrooms with ample storage and natural light
Two modern washrooms for added convenience
Fully equipped kitchen with high-end appliances
Beautiful private balcony – a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening wine
High-speed internet and all essential utilities included
Floor heating
Elevator access and secure building entry
All utilities are included in the rent (electricity, heating, water, internet, etc.)
Registration (Anmeldung) at the address is possible

Prime Location – Kreuzberg/Mitte Border

Situated on Markgrafenstraße 88, this apartment places you right at the intersection of Kreuzberg and Mitte — two of Berlin’s most sought-after districts. The area is rich in culture, dining, and history, offering something for everyone:

Steps from Gendarmenmarkt, one of Berlin's most beautiful squares
A short walk to Checkpoint Charlie and the historical Friedrichstraße
Countless cafes, restaurants, galleries, and boutiques within easy reach
Close to museums and theaters, including the Berlin State Opera and Humboldt Forum

Excellent Transport Connectivity:

Stadtmitte U-Bahn station (U2/U6) is just a 2-minute walk away
Multiple bus lines and cycling routes nearby
Direct connections to Alexanderplatz, Potsdamer Platz, and Hauptbahnhof
Quick access to the airport via public transport or taxi

This beautiful and magnificent turn of the 20th century style apartment with wooden floors and ornaments is ideally located at U wedding station. From there you can explore the entire city very easily.

Three bedroom flat, bathroom, kitchen and balcony overlooking the leafy side street. Sleeps 6. Excellent connection to local transport for city west, Prenzlauer Berg and Mitte. Close to local bars, clubs and restaurants. Ideal inexspensive choice to explore.

The flat comprises of a kitchen, bathroom and three bedrooms with 160x200cm double beds. All bedrooms get a lot of natural light as the apartment is on the 2nd floor, so there is sun almost all day long. There is also a decent size storage compartment in (hidden)ment allocated to the flat if you need more space. 1 large towel per guest provided, sheets and blankets provided. IF YOU NEED SMALL HAND TOWELS PLEASE BRING THEM WITH YOU. WE ARE TRYING TO MINIMIZE THE WASH LOAD AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT.

I am available 24/7 for my guests. I have lived in Berlin almost all my life so I can point you to all the hidden gems or put you in contact with the right people for almost all your needs. If anything is the matter I shouldn't be more than twenty minutes away at any given time.

Sprengelkiez is the area that everyone talks about at the moment. It has some great little pubs with live music acts who sometimes just happen to live above the bar itself. Nevertheless going out here is unpretentious and good value for money. Two supermarkets and cleaners are within a 5 min walk from the flat.

The flat is very well situated for public transport to city west, Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg as it is in walking distance to Amrumer Str and Wedding stations for the U and S Bahn networks.

title: Triftstraße, Berlin
description:
First Occupancy After Renovation – Charming 1-Room Apartment with Large Balcony in Berlin Mitte / Wedding
This newly renovated 1-room apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-maintained residential building with an elevator and offers approx. 38 sqm of modern living space in a central location. Situated in the Berlin-Mitte district of Wedding, the area combines urban living with a relaxed neighborhood atmosphere and excellent infrastructure.

Layout & Features:
Upon entering the apartment, you are welcomed by a functional hallway with space for a wardrobe and storage. The bright living room is generously sized and provides direct access to a spacious balcony, perfect for relaxing outdoors. The adjacent kitchen is separate and ideal for personal customization. The bathroom features a bathtub and has also been modernized during the renovation.

This apartment is available for first occupancy after complete renovation – walls, floors, electrical wiring, and sanitary facilities have all been updated to a high standard, allowing for immediate move-in without any additional work.

Highlights:
First occupancy after full renovation

3rd floor with elevator

Large balcony with a view

Bright and well-proportioned living room

Bathroom with bathtub

Separate kitchen

Quiet location with excellent transport connections


Erstbezug nach Sanierung – Charmante 1-Zimmer-Wohnung mit großem Balkon in Berlin Mitte Ortsteil Wedding

Diese frisch sanierte 1-Zimmer-Wohnung im 3. Obergeschoss eines gepflegten Mehrfamilienhauses mit Aufzug bietet auf ca. 38 m2 ein modernes Zuhause in zentraler Lage. Berlin-Mitte – verbindet urbanes Leben mit entspannter Nachbarschaftsatmosphäre und hervorragender Infrastruktur.

Beim Betreten der Wohnung empfängt Sie ein funktionaler Flur mit Platz für Garderobe und Stauraum. Die Wohnung präsentiert sich im Erstbezug nach umfassender Sanierung – Wände, Böden, Elektrik sowie sanitäre Einrichtungen wurden hochwertig erneuert und ermöglichen einen sofortigen Einzug ohne weiteren Renovierungsaufwand.

title: Beusselstraße, Berlin
description:
Modern & Cozy Apartment in Trendy Moabit – Fully Furnished with Great Amenities!
Welcome to your new home in the heart of Berlin-Moabit! This stylish and fully furnished apartment offers everything you need for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Located in a vibrant neighborhood, it combines modern design, bright interiors, and practical amenities, making it an ideal place to live.

The apartment features a fully equipped modular kitchen, complete with a refrigerator, coffee machine, water heater, and all the necessary crockery and cutlery. The comfortable sleeping area includes a spring bed (120 × 200 cm), fresh bedding, duvets, and a spacious wardrobe. A stylish dining area with a dining table, chairs, and a cozy carpet creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. The modern bathroom is fitted with a shower, a hairdryer, and fresh towels for your convenience.

For added comfort, the building offers laundry facilities in the basement, which can be reserved and paid for via an app. A passenger lift ensures easy access to all floors, while a shared balcony provides a perfect spot to unwind. Additionally, a free cleaning service is included once a month, making your stay even more effortless.
Please note that the pictures represent the room category, and slight variations in layout or furniture placement may apply.

As a special service, a final cleaning fee of 210 EUR includes fresh sheets, towels, bath mats, and slippers, which you can take with you after your stay.

Prime Location – Berlin-Moabit
This apartment is perfectly located in Moabit, one of Berlin’s most exciting and up-and-coming neighborhoods. Known for its trendy cafés, diverse restaurants, and vibrant cultural scene, Moabit offers a unique mix of urban energy and green spaces. The excellent public transport connections ensure that you can easily reach the city center, major business districts, and Berlin’s top attractions in no time.

Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity – book your stay now!

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
GEZ fees for TV and radio have to be paid separately by the tenant. In case of an early move-out, the tenant has to pay an extra fee. 
The deposit and the one-time cleaning fee must be fully transferred to the provider before move-in. Please note that without timely payment, the key handover cannot take place. Once the payment has been received, you will receive all further information for a smooth check-in.

title: Nazarethkirchstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to our beautiful newly renovated apartments, where you bring the spirit and we take care of the rest! 

Our large number of co-living apartments all consist of spacious and bright rooms in a modern design. The best part is, everything is already fully furnished. In other words, you can literally grab your suitcase and move in tomorrow!

Additionally, not only all of the rooms are already equipped with the essentials like electricity, water and internet, but we also offer numerous other facilities that are included in the price. Whether you would like to do sports in our fitness rooms, study in the coworking areas or socialise during organised workshops and events; we have it all!

We are located in ‘Wedding’, which has become one of the trendiest areas in Berlin, throughout recent years. With countless bars, restaurants and shops right around the corner, this district has everything you may need within walking distance. Furthermore, due to its central location, all other exciting parts of Berlin can easily be reached by public transportation, with U6 and U9 lines arriving at the Leopoldplatz (2-mintue walk) on a regular basis. 

With open-minded and international people this place will not only provide you with an amazing new home, but you will also be part of our international and open-minded community, that you do not want to miss out on.  

Services / facilities that are INCLUDED in the price: 
-	heating, electricity, water 
-	high speed internet
-	fitness room
-	community area
-	working spaces
-	gaming area 
-	security (camera surveillance)
-	outdoor areas that can be used as sports facilities 
-	bicycle parking spaces
-	community manager
- 	great location
- 	*laundry room (including washing machine & dryer)  

*Please note that although a common laundry room is included in the price, the costs per washing cycle / program are paid individually and are therefore not included in the overall price. 

Additional services / facilities that are NOT INCLUDED in the price: 
- 	parking space (can be booked on request) 


What exactly does “fully equipped” mean? 
Being able to move into a new place the next day does not happen very often, yet we make it possible! Therefore, we have not only taken care of all the necessary amenities, but these are also included in the price and do not involve any additional charges. 

To give you an overview of your new home, we have listed all of the integrated facilities below:

The apartment: 
•	equipped kitchen  
•	oven 
•	dishwasher 
•	*balcony / terrace

The bedroom:
•	wardrobe
•	desk
•	chair
•	mirror
•	lamp
•	bed (90 cm)
•	mattress
•	blanket
•	pillow
•	curtains
•	floor lamp
•	shelf 
•	drawer 
•	heating unit 
•	private balcony / terrace

*Please note that not all of the rooms have a balcony or terrace. Furthermore, those that do are sometimes shared and therefore more than one room may have access to the same balcony. The exact details of each individual room within the apartment can be seen on the according floorplan, which is included in the pictures. 

REQUIRED documents:
-	Proof of income (last 3 months) or work contract 
-	Proof of enrolment (students) 
-	Guarantor (only if you do not have proof of income) 
-	Copy of guarantor's ID (only if you do not have proof of income) 
- 	Copy of guarantor's work contract (only if you do not have proof of income) 

*the landlord only accepts tenants under the age of 40*

Check-in /out: 
-	Check-in hours: Monday - Friday from 10:00 - 16:00 
-	The key transfer will take place at Village M (you will receive the address once your booking is confirmed)

Please be aware once the booking is done on HousingAnywhere we will provide you with the contract. In order for you to get your keys, the deposit must be transferred to our bank account.

IMPORTANT!!! Please take into account that the decoration is solely included for inspirational purposes and will not be present in your room.

title: Stresemannstraße, Berlin
description:
This stunning, fully furnished luxury apartment is up for grabs, located right next to Potsdamer Platz with breathtaking views of the TV Tower and other historical landmarks.

Featuring three spacious bedrooms, one of which is currently set up as a stylish home office with a sofa bed—it can easily be converted into a third bedroom to suit your needs. The modern bathroom includes both a bathtub and a walk-in shower, plus there's a separate guest WC for added convenience.

The fully equipped kitchen boasts high-end appliances, including an induction cooker and a dishwasher, perfect for effortless cooking. The expansive living room is bathed in natural light, thanks to  the windows all around it that offer spectacular city views.

Security is top-notch—each apartment occupies its own private floor, and access is controlled via a secure elevator system, ensuring exclusive entry to your level. Additionally, the apartment comes with a private underground parking space.

For dining, the trendy Berta Restaurant is conveniently located on the ground floor, offering a perfect spot for dinner just steps from your door.

Potsdamer Platz is one of Berlin’s most vibrant and sought-after locations, offering a perfect blend of history, modern architecture, and urban convenience. Situated in the heart of the city, this dynamic district is known for its high-end living, cultural landmarks, and excellent connectivity.

Why Live in Potsdamer Platz?
✅ Central & Well-Connected

Located in Mitte, Berlin’s central district, making it ideal for professionals, expatriates, and families.
Excellent public transport links (U-Bahn, S-Bahn, buses) allow easy access to every part of the city.
Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER) is just 30 minutes away.

✅ Luxury & Convenience
Surrounded by world-class shopping malls, restaurants, and entertainment options, including the famous Mall of Berlin.
Trendy cafés, gourmet dining, and international cuisine are right at your doorstep.

✅ Cultural & Entertainment Hub
Close to historical landmarks like the Brandenburg Gate, Reichstag, and the Berlin Philharmonic.
Hosts the annual Berlin International Film Festival (Berlinale), attracting film lovers worldwide.
Home to theaters, art galleries, and museums, including the iconic Sony Center and the Museum of Film and Television.

✅ Green Spaces & Recreation
Steps away from Tiergarten, Berlin’s largest park, perfect for jogging, cycling, or relaxing outdoors.
Various fitness centers, yoga studios, and wellness facilities nearby.
✅ High-End Work & Living Spaces
A hub for corporate offices, embassies, and co-working spaces, making it a great choice for professionals.
Many expat-friendly services, international schools, and healthcare facilities in the vicinity.

title: Niebuhrstraße, Berlin
description:
This stunning, fully furnished three-bedroom designer apartment is a true masterpiece in the heart of Charlottenburg. Every detail has been carefully curated, featuring brand-new BoConcept furniture, elegant finishes, and original artwork by a renowned artist Thomas Delaroziere from Martinique.

The apartment combines contemporary sophistication with warmth and comfort — light-filled spaces, inspiring corners, and breathtaking views make it truly one of a kind. The state-of-the-art kitchen is designed for both cooking and connection — the perfect place to gather, entertain, and enjoy unforgettable evenings with friends.

Perfectly situated in elegant Charlottenburg, you’ll have effortless access to everything that makes Berlin vibrant and exciting — from fine dining and boutiques to cultural landmarks and green parks.

The art was curated from Thomas Delaroziere who was raised in Martinique and draws inspiration from the island’s untamed landscapes. His oil paintings—rooted in impressionism—explore the genius loci, capturing the emotional essence of place shaped by memory, myth, and cultural heritage.

The apartment offers you many advantages for a pleasant stay. See for yourself. Here you will feel like in your second home.

This beautiful 2-room apartment in a fantastic turn of the century building offers a spacious 55 qm with high ceiling as well as wodden flooring and a sunny and enhancing balcony. The apartment is located on the 4th floor. More central than this location you cannot find! Public transportation near by so that you can reach any part of Berlin in no time. Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße, located in Charlottenburg, Berlin, is a historic avenue that intertwines past and present. Lined with architectural elegance, the street narrates Berlin's journey through the ages. Named after Emperor Friedrich III, its essence is one of regal charm.

Prominently featuring turn-of-the-century architecture, Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße is a testament to Berlin's historical evolution. Strolling along the avenue, you're immersed in a visual tale, as Art Nouveau facades stand alongside modern structures. This architectural dialogue paints a vivid picture of the city's transformation.

The street's dynamic character is balanced by its tranquil aura. While situated amidst the urban pulse, Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße offers an escape into a quieter realm. Sidewalk cafes, bookstores, and boutique shops evoke an unhurried atmosphere, inviting leisurely exploration.

Anchored in Charlottenburg's historical fabric, the street echoes the district's heritage. It's not merely a path but a portal to Berlin's illustrious past. The nearby Charlottenburg Palace, a symbol of Prussian grandeur, contributes to the street's regal air.

Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße's accessibility underscores its significance. Well-connected to transportation networks, it's a gateway to Berlin's broader landscape. This integration enhances the street's role as both a local gem and a conduit for exploration.

As twilight descends, Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße morphs into a nocturnal canvas. Restaurants and bars come alive, infusing the street with a cosmopolitan energy. The transition mirrors Berlin's dual identity: traditional and modern, historical and avant-garde.

Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße encapsulates Berlin's multifaceted identity. It's a symphony of history and modernity, elegance and accessibility. Whether you're a history enthusiast, an architecture admirer, or a leisure seeker, the street beckons with its timeless allure.

Kantstraße, situated in the bustling metropolis of Berlin, holds a prominent position as a vibrant and diverse thoroughfare that weaves together history, culture, and urban life. Stretching through the Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district, this iconic street has become a microcosm of the city's past, present, and future.

Named after the renowned philosopher Immanuel Kant, Kantstraße boasts a rich historical lineage that dates back to the 19th century. What once began as a trade route has since transformed into a multifaceted avenue that encapsulates Berlin's evolution. The street's architecture showcases a blend of styles, ranging from classical buildings that survived the war to contemporary structures that epitomize Berlin's modernity.

Kantstraße is celebrated for its eclectic blend of offerings. The street is a gastronomic delight, hosting a diverse range of restaurants, cafes, and eateries that span international cuisines. From traditional German dishes to exotic flavors from around the world, Kantstraße caters to the diverse palates of both locals and visitors.

Additionally, Kantstraße serves as a shopping paradise, housing a mix of boutique shops, designer stores, and local markets. The street's commercial energy is palpable, inviting individuals to explore fashion, antiques, and artisanal crafts.

This street is also deeply connected to Berlin's transportation network, with major roads intersecting and accessible public transit options nearby. This connectivity makes Kantstraße a hub of movement and a gateway to other parts of the city, enhancing its role as a pivotal point in urban navigation.

As day transitions into night, Kantstraße transforms into an energetic hub of nightlife and entertainment. The street's theaters, bars, and clubs come alive, attracting both locals and tourists seeking to revel in Berlin's renowned after-dark scene.

In conclusion, Kantstraße represents Berlin's narrative of transformation and convergence. It is a symphony of historical resonance, cultural diversity, and modern dynamism. Whether one is drawn to its culinary offerings, shopping experiences, or vibrant nightlife, Kantstraße offers a captivating journey through the multifaceted identity of the German capital.

The apartment will accommodate 4 in total, with two double bedrooms. It is fully furnished with a new TV, fully equipped kitchen for entertaining and an inviting dining area. We will provide everything you need like linens and towels .

The apartment is located in the up-and-coming area of Berlin – the Wedding district, in the borough of Mitte. The Wedding district is home to many students and artists.
It is conveniently just a 5 minute walk to the underground station Seestraße with the U6 line and various street cars and buses.
This area is also perfect for doctors/med students as it only a 3 minute walk to the Charité University and hospital.
The area features many Cafés, restaurants and supermarkets and very well connected with the rest of Berlin. It provides a unique multicultural flair.

Please note:
- The first month's rent will be completed through HousingAnywhere. Also, the deposit and fee need to be paid through HousingAnywhere payments and should be completed not later than 2 days before moving in.
